property_summary: For any address, Collect must not permanently change the reentrancy guard: the reference leaves locked_ false so any later Collect call by an unlocked account with sufficient balance and elapsed unlock time can still succeed, while the bug leaves locked_ true forever so every subsequent call reverts.
change_summary: Removed `locked_ = false;` in the nonReentrant_ modifier, permanently locking the contract after the first guarded call.
